why: Opens every session on the Launch route, which is what production did before issue #317. boot.ts rebuilds the whole session on a Campaign<->Versus switch, so this re-shows 'press any key or tap to begin' to a player who already dismissed it -- the acceptance criterion 'the Launch gate appears at most once per document load'. Invisible to every session-level test in loop.test.ts, because one session in isolation SHOULD open at Launch, and invisible to boot.test.ts, which fakes startGame. Killed only by the boot+startGameWith seam, which composes the real boot() with the real startGameWith over the REAL state machine. Kills BOTH dismissal tests (pointer and keyboard), because neither session can reach a dismissed gate: 2 of 4 in that suite. Widened by issue #317's session-host work: 3 of 397 now. The two pre-existing Launch-gate cases ('a Campaign -> Versus reboot does not replay the splash' and 'a KEYBOARD dismissal reports to the page too') both still fail, joined by the repeated-session route's 'never replays the Launch gate, and never paints a retired session over the new one'. The failing SET was compared on both sides rather than the count renumbered. RE-ANCHORED by issue #468, and the reachability of the defect changed with it. The line moved from `startGameWith` to `route-host.ts`, where it is evaluated ONCE PER PAGE rather than once per session -- so a reboot can no longer replay the splash by rebuilding a machine, because no machine is rebuilt. What this mutation now describes is a page that opens on the splash after a reload the gate should have been carried through, which is the surviving half of the original criterion. `route-host.test.ts` joins its scope because that is where the page-level route decision now lives; the count below is the re-measured one, not the pre-move one: 3 of the old scope became 1 of 425, because the reboot cases it used to kill are now covered by attach() rather than by rebuilding a machine. The surviving killer is route-host.test.ts s opens on Main Menu when the gate was already dismissed, which was written FOR this entry after the re-anchor showed it SURVIVING 0 of 423. Pinned by NAME since issue #504 rather than by a count: the count drifted from 2 to 3 when issue #496 added tests to the same file, and only one of those three failures is the load-bearing one -- the two incidental failures would make this entry brittle if they were named too.
killedBy: createRouteHost: where the page opens opens on Main Menu when the gate was already dismissed
